questions.question: The user says "fix this bug in Mixdog". There is a checkout at ~/project/mixdog. Should the fix be made there? Where should the change go instead?
questions.expected: No; sibling fork is not a PaseoDog input; use a hash-gated scripts/patch-mixdog.mjs patch or an npm pin bump in this repo
questions.answer: No; fork not referenced; patch-mixdog.mjs patch (step 8) or pin bump (steps 4-7)

questions.question: Is it allowed to directly edit a file under tools/node_modules/@getpaseo/server to fix a daemon bug? Why?
questions.expected: No; npm ci restores it, next patch apply reports drift, bypasses hash review; ship as gated patch wired into tools postinstall
questions.answer: No; npm ci restores, drift, no hash review; gated patch via tools postinstall or pin bump

questions.question: Which directories hold PaseoDog's own runtime state, and which personal profile directories must not be edited?
A teammate wants to backport one Paseo PR. What file to create/extend, how it is wired into install, and what must be recorded?
questions.expected: scripts/patch-*.mjs with PR header, version, original hash, --apply|--check; tools postinstall; docs/UPSTREAM.md backport line + CHANGELOG
questions.answer: patch-*.mjs with PR/version/hash/--apply|--check; tools postinstall; docs/UPSTREAM.md + CHANGELOG; check/test, reload
